direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Kasun has just returned Anudi's phone and she has thanked him. He gently puts her at ease.
direction.people: Kasun stands at frame right facing Anudi offscreen to the left. He wears a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, with both empty hands at his sides. He feels friendly and unhurried.

flow.text: Kasun keeps his eyes on Anudi, a small smile resting on his face.

flow.how: Gently and matter-of-factly, easing her embarrassment with a slight incline of his head

flow.text: His lips settle and he holds her gaze, leaving room for her response.

direction.camera: Locked-off eye-level medium close-up from the road side, with Kasun at frame right and his food three-wheeler behind him.
direction.sound: Light rain and distant traffic; no music.
